selections.heading: WO-001 intent framing
selections.text: Civic observability is the visibility layer that makes silence unmaintainable; trust signals (status trail, push, feel-heard feedback) are how observability translates into restored trust. (learned 2026-10-04)

selections.heading: WO-001 target customer
selections.text: The design optimisation target is the Rahim archetype (Persona 02); the broader Dhaka-tech-comfortable cohort is the post-pilot acceptance population, not the v1 surface. (learned 2026-10-04)

selections.heading: Per-Bolt cadence
selections.text: For feature-scope work, the per-Bolt design-log entry is the leanest cadence that still satisfies team.md Mandated; no additional daily or weekly cadence is required. (learned 2026-10-04)
